description: Stackurity's curated catalogue of Windows programs matched against vulnerability data. Names, publishers and version forms were checked against real Add/Remove Programs entries (internal/winprograms/testdata/registry); each source was checked against the advisories it returns (go test -tags measure ./internal/intel -run TestMeasureWindowsPrograms). Programs not listed are coverage gaps, never clean.

programs.label: Google Chrome
programs.update: Chrome updates itself when restarted; managed estates deploy the Chrome Enterprise installer.
programs.note: Beta, Dev and Canary channels have other names and are not matched. Per-user installs (HKCU) are not inventoried.

programs.label: Microsoft Edge
programs.update: Edge updates itself when restarted; managed estates use Microsoft Edge Update policies or the Edge MSI.
programs.note: Microsoft's Security Update Guide lists the Edge build fixing each CVE, including the Chromium CVEs Edge takes in (709 CVEs in the 2026-Oct document). NVD's edge_chromium CPE lists only Edge's own CVEs, so it is not used. Fixes are read per major. A version on a major Microsoft lists no fix for depends on whether that line is still updated: Extended Stable (even majors, listed next to Stable) keeps an 8-week grace after its last such listing, and the CVEs fixed only on other lines are one coverage note on its rows; an older Stable major, or an Extended Stable line taken over by the next, is confirmed affected with the next listed line's fix.

programs.label: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime
programs.unmatched: Microsoft's advisories list Microsoft Edge, not the WebView2 Runtime, and no source states which runtime builds fix which CVEs

programs.label: Mozilla Firefox
programs.update: Firefox updates itself; managed estates deploy Mozilla's MSI.
programs.note: Mozilla's advisories list the Firefox release fixing each CVE. NVD has not analysed close to half of Mozilla's recent CVEs (263 of 573 mentioning Firefox in the 120 days to 2026-10-30), so it is not used. Per-user installs (HKCU) are not inventoried.

programs.label: Mozilla Firefox ESR
programs.update: Install the latest Firefox ESR release of the same ESR line.
programs.note: Mozilla lists a fix per ESR line (ESR 115.16.1 and ESR 128.3.1): each fixes its own line. A version on a line Mozilla lists no fix for depends on whether Mozilla still fixes that line: a supported ESR line (a CVE fixed only on the 153 line, on a patched 115 host) gets the CVE as part of a coverage note, not a finding; an ended ESR line (128 after its last release) is confirmed affected with the next listed line's fix.

programs.label: Mozilla Thunderbird
programs.update: Thunderbird updates itself; managed estates deploy Thunderbird's MSI.
programs.note: Mozilla lists a fix per Thunderbird line (the ESR 153.6 and the monthly 159): each fixes its own line. A version on a line with no listed fix depends on whether Mozilla still fixes that line: Thunderbird's ESR gets such CVEs as part of a coverage note, not findings; an older monthly release is confirmed affected with the next listed line's fix.

programs.label: 7-Zip
programs.update: 7-Zip does not update itself: install the new version from 7-zip.org over the old one.
programs.note: The MSI records 26.02.00.0 for 26.02; only major.minor is compared, as 7-Zip numbers its releases.
programs.coverage_note: NVD has not analysed most of 7-Zip's recent CVEs (6 of 8 published in the 120 days to 2026-10-30 have no configuration): findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed, so a version can be vulnerable without a finding.

programs.label: WinRAR
programs.update: WinRAR does not update itself: install the new version from rarlab.com over the old one.
programs.note: Beta builds ("WinRAR 7.20 beta 1") are not matched.
programs.coverage_note: Findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed.

programs.label: Notepad++
programs.update: Use Notepad++'s updater, or install the new version from notepad-plus-plus.org.
programs.coverage_note: NVD has not analysed Notepad++'s recent CVEs (none of 12 published in the 120 days to 2026-10-30 has a configuration): findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed, so a version can be vulnerable without a finding.

programs.label: PuTTY
programs.update: PuTTY does not update itself: install the new MSI from the PuTTY download page.
programs.coverage_note: Findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed.

programs.label: WinSCP
programs.update: Use WinSCP's update check, or install the new version from winscp.net.
programs.coverage_note: Findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed.

programs.label: VLC media player
programs.unmatched: NVD has analysed none of VLC's CVEs since 2023 (7 published in the 120 days to 2026-10-30 have no configuration), so current releases would look clean

programs.label: Git for Windows
programs.update: Run "git update-git-for-windows", or install the new version from gitforwindows.org.
programs.note: Git for Windows numbers its own rebuilds as a fourth part (2.53.0.2 is v2.53.0.windows.2), which is kept.
programs.coverage_note: Findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed; NVD analyses Git for Windows' CVEs late, so a version can be vulnerable without a finding.

programs.label: Python
programs.update: Install the latest release of the same Python line from python.org.
programs.note: Only the installer's bundle entry is matched; its parts ("Python 3.12.3 Core Interpreter (64-bit)") are not. The registry version (3.12.3150.0) encodes the release level, so the version is read from the name. Pre-releases are not matched. The default per-user install (HKCU) is not inventoried.
programs.coverage_note: Findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed (2 of 4 CPython CVEs published in the 120 days to 2026-10-30 had no configuration), so a version can be vulnerable without a finding.

programs.label: Node.js
programs.update: Install the latest release of the same Node.js line from nodejs.org.
programs.coverage_note: Findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed; NVD analyses Node.js CVEs late, so a version can be vulnerable without a finding.

programs.label: OpenSSL for Windows (Shining Light)
programs.update: Install the new build from slproweb.com.
programs.note: OpenSSL 1.1.1 and older use letter suffixes (1.1.1w), which are not read: those installs are not evaluated. OpenSSL linked into other programs is not seen.
programs.coverage_note: Findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed, so a version can be vulnerable without a finding.

programs.label: Oracle VirtualBox
programs.unmatched: NVD records Oracle's VirtualBox CVEs as the latest affected release only ("the supported version that is affected is 7.2.16"), so earlier releases would look clean

programs.label: AnyDesk
programs.note: The registry records "ad 9.0.9"; the "ad" prefix is dropped.
programs.unmatched: NVD lists most of AnyDesk's recent CVEs as the one version tested (9.0.4), not as a range, so earlier versions would look clean

programs.label: Zoom Workplace
programs.update: Zoom updates itself unless updates are disabled; otherwise deploy the new installer from zoom.us/download.
programs.note: The per-machine (MSI) install records major.minor.build (7.0.33767), which does not name the release, so it is not evaluated; the user installer records "7.0.6 (43848)". Ranges NVD records for macOS, Linux and mobile clients only are not applied.
programs.coverage_note: Findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed (Zoom's 2 CVEs published in the 120 days to 2026-10-30 had no configuration yet), so a version can be vulnerable without a finding.

programs.label: Adobe Acrobat and Acrobat Reader (Continuous)
programs.update: Acrobat updates itself unless updates are disabled; otherwise use Help, Check for Updates or deploy Adobe's update package.
programs.note: Reader and Acrobat share one installer and version since 2023 ("Adobe Acrobat (64-bit)" for both). The Continuous track's versions end in a 2xxxx build (26.001.21346); the Classic track (3xxxx) has its own entry. Ranges NVD records for the Classic track are never applied to Continuous installs.

programs.label: Adobe Acrobat and Acrobat Reader (Classic)
programs.update: Install the latest update of the same Classic track (2020 or 2024) from Adobe.
programs.note: Classic track versions end in a 3xxxx build (20.005.30574, 24.001.30429).

programs.label: .NET Runtime
programs.update: Install the latest .NET runtime of the same major version from dot.net, or through Microsoft Update.
programs.note: Microsoft's Security Update Guide lists the runtime version fixing each CVE per .NET line (".NET 8.0 runtime installed on Windows": 8.0.32); SDK versions (8.0.427) are not read. The registry version of these entries (64.108.52182) is the MSI's, so the version is read from the name. Host, Host FX Resolver, SDK and targeting pack entries are not matched. .NET Framework is part of Windows and is not evaluated. A line Microsoft no longer lists a fix for (an out-of-support .NET 6) is confirmed affected with the next listed line's fix; supported lines are always listed together.

programs.label: ASP.NET Core Runtime
programs.update: Install the latest ASP.NET Core runtime (or Hosting Bundle) of the same major version from dot.net, or through Microsoft Update.
programs.note: Microsoft's Security Update Guide lists the version fixing each CVE per ASP.NET Core line ("ASP.NET Core 8.0": 8.0.32). The runtime bundle and its shared framework are two entries for one installation: findings are reported once. A line Microsoft no longer lists a fix for (an out-of-support ASP.NET Core 6) is confirmed affected with the next listed line's fix.

programs.label: Wireshark
programs.update: Use Wireshark's update check, or install the latest release of the same line from wireshark.org.

programs.label: LibreOffice
programs.update: Install the latest release of the same LibreOffice line from libreoffice.org.
programs.note: The fourth part of the registry version (25.8.3.2) is a build number and is not compared. Help packs and language packs are separate entries and are not matched.
programs.coverage_note: Findings come from the CVEs NVD has analysed; NVD has deferred several recent LibreOffice CVEs, so a version can be vulnerable without a finding.

programs.label: Foxit PDF Reader
programs.update: Use Help, Check for Updates, or install the new version from foxit.com.

programs.label: FileZilla Client
programs.unmatched: NVD lists most of FileZilla's recent CVEs as single versions, not as ranges, so other versions would look clean

programs.label: KeePass Password Safe
programs.unmatched: NVD has analysed none of KeePass's CVEs since 2023, so current releases would look clean

programs.label: VMware Tools
programs.unmatched: NVD deferred analysis of VMware Tools' recent CVEs (CVE-2025-22230, CVE-2025-22247), so they would look clean; Broadcom's advisories are not read yet

programs.label: TeamViewer
programs.unmatched: NVD deferred analysis of TeamViewer's CVEs since 2024 (CVE-2024-7479; 17 published in the 120 days to 2026-10-30 have no configuration), so they would look clean

programs.label: Oracle Java SE
programs.unmatched: NVD records Oracle's Java CVEs as the latest affected update of each supported line only (8u491, 17.0.19), so earlier updates and unsupported lines (Java 24) would look clean; Oracle's Critical Patch Update data is not read yet
programs.note: "Java Auto Updater" is a separate entry and is not Java.

programs.label: Eclipse Temurin
programs.unmatched: no advisory source names Temurin builds (NVD has no Temurin CPE), and Oracle's Java SE CVEs do not all apply to OpenJDK builds
